world 0 (key deferred).reader_note: Ten-year suspension, then the same quarrels return and get settled, means deferred.

world 1 (key entrenched).reader_note: Permanent rights with no yielding and quarrels inherited for generations = entrenched; never more bitter, at once, same courts kill others.

world 2 (key channeled).reader_note: Protest moved from roadblocks to petitions, conflict unchanged = channeled; 'as many and as bitter', 'heard them at once' and the price-driven end kill escalated, deferred, entrenched.

world 3 (key escalated).reader_note: Petitions turned to blockades and arson; quarrels died after repeal kills entrenched, channeled weakly excluded.

world 1 (key archive).reader_note: Coming to hear what the town once was means archive; no current affairs and not trade kill forum and clearinghouse.

world 2 (key battleground).reader_note: Factions fought and brawled over stalls = battleground; shouting down speakers kills forum, same goods undercuts clearinghouse, archive only implicit.

world 3 (key clearinghouse).reader_note: Notices collected and passed on without debate = clearinghouse; forum is a near miss, killed only by 'without comment or debate'.

world 0 (key forum).reader_note: Open debate reaching shared views = forum; 'heard each other out' kills battleground, clearinghouse only weakly excluded.

world 2 (key ceremonial).reader_note: Feast, procession, pledges with no fees or rules point to ceremonial; seizing ships and unchanged traffic kill candid and expedient.

world 3 (key exhaustive).reader_note: 300 clauses covering even rare cases = exhaustive; never named seizures, refused quick truce, enforced a century kill the rest.

world 0 (key candid).reader_note: Openly stated distrust and possible failure = candid; few clauses, two years of talks and decades of enforcement kill exhaustive, expedient, ceremonial.

world 1 (key expedient).reader_note: Drafted fast for a temporary need; mocked pledges, two clauses, actually used kill candid, exhaustive, ceremonial.

world 3 (key abandoned).reader_note: Members sold furnaces and stopped making glass, so abandoned; outsiders all over the city kill confined.

world 0 (key doubled).reader_note: Each shop fired twice as many pieces = doubled; kept making, every quarter, cheap so no longer gifts kill the rest.

world 1 (key elevated).reader_note: Council seats and royal gifts = elevated; every quarter, kept making and old pace kill confined, abandoned, doubled.

world 2 (key confined).reader_note: All workshops moved to one island; kept making, plain good, old pace kill abandoned, elevated, doubled.

world 0 (key coercive).reader_note: Armed guards and fear mean coercive; new, seized by the president, no lord above kill the rest.

world 1 (key customary).reader_note: Obeyed 'as our grandfathers did' = customary; no guards or fines kills coercive, five eldest decided every question kills diffuse, ancillary only implicit.

world 2 (key diffuse).reader_note: No single person or place held power = diffuse; no guards, yearly rewrites and no higher authority kill coercive, customary, ancillary.

world 3 (key ancillary).reader_note: Steward only carries out court orders and punishes no one; 'single steward' and 'charter' kill diffuse and customary.

world 1 (key compass).reader_note: Leaders steered by it and kept its course means compass; no new members, active during campaign, and continuing without it kill engine, epilogue, crutch.

world 2 (key crutch).reader_note: Total reliance and collapse after closure = crutch; notices-only/no side/throughout kill engine, compass, epilogue.

world 3 (key epilogue).reader_note: Began after victory, printed memoirs and obituaries = epilogue; disbanded branches and taking no side kill engine, compass, crutch.

world 0 (key engine).reader_note: Branches sprang up wherever it circulated; took no side, founded first year, branches self-funded kill the rest.

world 2 (key embellished).reader_note: Invented drowned mayor and bell means embellished; no sales, no contests, more resentment kill the others.

world 3 (key commercialized).reader_note: Admission charges and pennant sales = commercialized; 'just as court papers did' and rowdier kill embellished/defused, but a school taking over an informal game could read as formalized.

world 0 (key defused).reader_note: No contest left to fight over = defused; 'nothing sold or told' kills commercialized and embellished, and the forgetting kills formalized.

world 1 (key formalized).reader_note: Written code, scheduled contests, trophy; told as court papers did, held free, more fights kill the rest.

world 3 (key experimental).reader_note: One year, two wards, different rules to compare means experimental; short form, generous, ignoring fashion kill the rest.

world 0 (key frugal).reader_note: A week of flour and coal at a tenth the cost = frugal; short form and ignoring popular methods kill cumbersome/fashionable, but designing alone against prevailing methods could read as experimental.

world 1 (key cumbersome).reader_note: Three offices, six forms, months of waiting = cumbersome; generous payments, ignored fashions and the unchanged run kill frugal, fashionable, experimental.

world 2 (key fashionable).reader_note: Copied scheme sweeping every city; unchanged 30 years, short form, generous kill experimental, cumbersome, frugal.
